## Stuffing (Thanksgiving) 

| Servings | Time | Source |
|:---|:---|:-------------------|
| 4 servings  | 75-90 min | Based on Mom's Betty Crocker Cookbook & [Sam Cooks Kindness: Crispy Italian Tofu Sausage Crumbles](https://samcookskindness.com/crispy-italian-tofu-sausage-crumbles/#recipe)  | 


### Ingredients:

- 8 cups of bread, cubed (1 17oz white loaf of Heaven's Gluten-Free bread) 
  * original recipe recommends toasting bread or cutting and leaving out for a day to dry out 
  * skip this step because (1) gluten free bread is already pretty dry and (2) tofu crumbles don't have extra moisture/grease so we're already adding moisture with broth 
- tofu crumbles 
  * 1 pack tofu (14-16oz) 
  * 2 TBSP tamari/soy sauce 
  * 1 tsp smoked paprika 
  * 1 tsp garlic powder
  * 1 tsp fennel (seed or ground) 
  * 0.5 tsp onion powder 
  * 2 tsp oregano 
  * 0.25 tsp red pepper flakes or cayenne (omit or add more depending on desired spice level)
- 1 cup onion, diced 
- 1.5 cup celery, diced 
- 1 tsp sage (3tsp/1TBSP if fresh) 
- 1.5 tsp thyme (4.5tsp/1.5TBSP if fresh) 
- 1 cup butter (2 sticks, often use earth balance
- 2 tsp salt 
- 0.25 cup broth 

### Directions 


**Prep** 

- Put tofu in freezer the night before, take-out in the morning and let thaw in the sink 
- preheat oven to 400F
- once tofu thawed, squeeze out excess water 
- wrap in towel and press (with book or heavy pot/pan) to extract more moisture; leave for 15-20 min
- crumble by hand into bowl 
- mix tamari & spice in small dish and then add to tofu and mix thoroughly 
- put onto lined baking sheet and bake at 400F for 20-25 min 
- while tofu is cooking: 
  * cut up celery/onion/bread (and spices if using fresh) 
  * melt butter in skillet 
  * add onion/celery and cook until soft 
- when tofu is done add to skillet with celery/onion/butter and mix
- add spices to skillet and mix 
- add 1/3 of bread cubes and mix 
- take full mixture and put into bowl with remaining 2/3 bread and mix 
- add 1/4 broth 
  * more/less depending on preference
  * using tofu recipe does not have any extra moisture or grease 
- grease pan (butter, olive oil, avocado oil, ect)
- pack into baking dish (required dish that is ~4Q/4L)
- cover with aluminum foil or lid and put in refrigerator 


**Bake** 

- cover with aluminum foil 
- bake for 60min at 350F
  * bake for 40-45 min covered
  * last 15-20 min uncover to crisp up top
